description: This file appears to be a PHP source code file that implements the logic for the third step of a mail merge process in the SuiteCRM platform. It manages session variables, loads templates, interacts with database beans for contacts and documents, and dynamically generates HTML form elements to facilitate user interaction in a web-based mail merge step.

classes.name: XTemplate
classes.description: This class is used for template rendering and variable substitution within the HTML template 'modules/MailMerge/Step3.html'.

classes.name: BeanFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of bean objects such as documents and contacts.

methods.name: generateSelect
methods.description: Generates a SQL SELECT statement to retrieve related records using the relationship defined in the seed bean.
